text.p: Belgian shares closed lower on Wednesday, as lack of fresh news kept buyers at bay and some players took profit while the market was still near its historical highs.
The Bel-20 index .BFX ended 0.49 percent or 8.50 points lower at 1,743.05, with overall Belgian shares volume a moderate to strong 2.2 billion francs worth.

Steel cord maker Bekaert, retailer Colruyt and pharmaceutical group UCB all lost about 1.5 percent. The three are among several other shares which wil see their weighting reduced in the Bel-20 index reshuffle on September 20.
